question: Find the display names of users who authored child posts (i.e., posts with a non-null ParentId) that have no comments and are associated—through post history—with only one distinct PostHistoryTypeId per user. Among these users, return only those whose highest-scoring qualifying post ranks in the top 10 by score.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT
        p."XCL_026" AS PostId,
        p."XCL_031" AS Score,
        p."XCL_033" AS AuthorId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments c
          WHERE c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
      )
),
user_history_counts AS (
    SELECT
        qp.AuthorId
    FROM qualifying_posts qp
    INNER JOIN postHistory ph ON qp.PostId = ph."XCL_014"
    GROUP BY qp.AuthorId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph."XCL_013") = 1
),
user_top_scores AS (
    SELECT
        qp.AuthorId,
        MAX(qp.Score) AS HighestScore
    FROM qualifying_posts qp
    INNER JOIN user_history_counts uhc ON qp.AuthorId = uhc.AuthorId
    GROUP BY qp.AuthorId
)
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName
FROM user_top_scores uts
INNER JOIN users u ON uts.AuthorId = u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY uts.HighestScore DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT
        p."XCL_026" AS PostId,
        p."XCL_031" AS Score,
        p."XCL_033" AS AuthorId,
        ph."XCL_015" AS PostHistoryTypeId
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
    INNER JOIN postHistory ph ON p."XCL_026" = ph."XCL_014"
    WHERE p."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
      AND c."XCL_006" IS NULL
),
user_history_counts AS (
    SELECT
        AuthorId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT PostHistoryTypeId) AS DistinctHistoryTypes
    FROM qualifying_posts
    GROUP BY AuthorId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PostHistoryTypeId) = 1
),
user_top_scores AS (
    SELECT
        qp.AuthorId,
        MAX(qp.Score) AS HighestScore
    FROM qualifying_posts qp
    INNER JOIN user_history_counts uhc ON qp.AuthorId = uhc.AuthorId
    GROUP BY qp.AuthorId
)
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName
FROM user_top_scores uts
INNER JOIN users u ON uts.AuthorId = u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY uts.HighestScore DESC

),

ranked_users AS (
